threads.body: The README now documents `otel.instrumentation.couchbase.experimental-span-attributes` as defaulting to `true`, but the javaagent implementation reads the corresponding declarative config with a `false` fallback (see CouchbaseRequestTracer `getBoolean(..., false)`) and the tests only enable it explicitly in `testStableSemconvExperimental`. Please align the documented default with the actual default behavior/value.

threads.body: The README now states this flag defaults to `true`, but Couchbase 2.x instrumentations still declare/behave with a default of `false` (see `instrumentation/couchbase/couchbase-2.0/metadata.yaml` and `couchbase-2.6/metadata.yaml`). Since this README covers Couchbase instrumentation broadly, the default should be documented as version-dependent (or clarified in the description) to avoid misleading 2.x users.

threads.body: `attribute(String, boolean)` only forwards attributes when `emitOldDatabaseSemconv()` is enabled. In stable database semconv mode this drops any boolean Couchbase attributes (including `db.couchbase.*` experimental attributes when enabled), while the String/long overloads do support stable translation + experimental passthrough. Consider mirroring the stable/experimental handling here for consistency.

threads.body: `attribute(String, boolean)` currently ignores stable database semconv mode and only emits when `emitOldDatabaseSemconv()` is enabled. This is inconsistent with the String/long overloads and prevents boolean `db.couchbase.*` experimental attributes from being captured under stable semconv.

threads.body: `attribute(String, boolean)` only delegates in old database semconv mode. In stable semconv mode this means boolean attributes are always dropped, even when `experimental_span_attributes` is enabled (unlike the String/long overloads).

threads.body: `setAttribute(String, boolean)` only forwards when `emitOldDatabaseSemconv()` is enabled. In stable database semconv mode, this drops boolean attributes entirely (including any `db.couchbase.*` experimental attributes when enabled), while the String/long overloads support stable translation + experimental passthrough. Consider adding the same stable/experimental handling here for consistency.
